part 1a.defaultText: Cradle is a dangerous world and it's important to make sure you have powerful gear in your arsenal in order to survive.  To do that, you will need to use the Forge.

responses.defaultText: What is the Forge?

part 2a.defaultText: The Forge uses the heat stored in your gear and combines it with the power of Fire Crystals to unlock its new potential.

responses.defaultText: Continue

part 3a.defaultText: In town, you can access the Forge at any time.  In the Clockworks, you can access it by using an Arsenal Station.

responses.defaultText: Continue

part 4a.defaultText: When using the Forge, you will see a list of any items that are ready to level up. Selecting an item will show you how it can be enhanced.

responses.defaultText: Continue

part 5a.defaultText: Each item will require a specific type of Fire Crystal.  Fire Crystals can be obtained from the Supply Depot, earned by completing certain missions, and found in treasure blocks in the Clockworks!

responses.defaultText: How do Fire Crystals work?

part 6a.defaultText:
Fire Crystals are somewhat unstable, the amount needed for a successful forge varies. 
Additionally, we've discovered that adding more Fire Crystals results in chances at special bonuses that will be applied to the item!

responses.defaultText: Sounds great!

part 7a.defaultText: Now that you know about the Forge, would you like to give it a look?

responses.defaultText: Sure! (Open the Forge)
I'll look at it later. (End conversation)

part 1.defaultText: Spiral HQ has us investigating reports that pieces of fallen tortodrones and clusters of dark matter are appearing all over the Clockworks. Kora believes the Fiends are up to something. There is evidence they played a hand in the disappearance of the tortodrones.

responses.defaultText: What did you find?

part 2.defaultText: Tucked away inside a mysterious garden we found a strange portal that HQ is calling a Grim Gate. From what we were able to decode you will need a key of sorts to open it. Spiral HQ thinks the glyphs we spotted the Fiends carrying might have something to do with opening the gate.

responses.defaultText: Thanks for the tip! I'll track down those glyphs.

part 1a.defaultText: Hello there little one. You look as though you require knowledge of some kind.

responses.defaultText: Tell me what you know about the Clockworks.
Nothing at this time, thanks.

part 2a.defaultText: I will share with you what I know, little one.

responses.defaultText: How old are the Clockworks?
How were the Clockworks created?
What lies at the core of the Clockworks?
On second thought, I've got some adventuring to do. Bye!

part 3a.defaultText:
It is hard to know exactly as so much of what is within seems to hold their origin from different worlds. Some appear to be from realms of great antiquity, no doubt once home to innumerable old gods and creatures.

This world is an unnatural one. What you see within it was never meant to be here. The great histories of so many worlds endlessly churning through the cogs of this great machine... I find it quite sad.

responses.defaultText: I've got another question.
Thanks for the info tall guy, see you around town.

part 3b.defaultText: There are different theories. Some say the gremlins that you see working on it now are responsible. But that seems too great even for their seemingly infinite work force. Even with the means to do so, how did they "start?" Where did they find the power?

responses.defaultText: I've got another question.
Thanks for the info tall guy, see you around town.

part 3c.defaultText:
Something of immense power, little one. There is an enormous energy signal coming from the center of the Clockworks, but that is all we know. No one has ever made it to the core. Or at least if anyone has, they have never returned.

The ones to ask would be the gremlins, for they have likely gone deeper into the Clockworks than any creature. But that might prove difficult as they are quite a disagreeable lot.

responses.defaultText: I've got another question.
Thanks for the info tall guy, see you around town.

part 1a.defaultText: Please be careful not to step on any of the snipes, little one.

responses.defaultText: Snipes?

part 2a.defaultText: The snipes are the graceful, adorable, fetchingly-corpulent birds you see roaming about Haven. Some say they are the most beautiful creatures in the galaxy, but you would never hear that from the snipes themselves as they are incredibly modest.

responses.defaultText: End conversation

part 1a.defaultText: Greetings!  Beyond this door you will find the advanced training hall. As a Spiral Knight, you are free to use it to practice your skills and learn more about the Clockworks.

responses.defaultText: Thanks! I'll go see what's inside.

part 1a.defaultText: Welcome to Haven, little one. Please join your friends in procuring shinies from the Clockworks. Shinies are always appreciated by the Strangers.

responses.defaultText: End conversation

part 1a.defaultText: Do you know what the most important resource on Cradle is? ENERGY! That's right my friend, something so special it's worth shouting about! Want to know about this super important stuff? I happen to be an expert on the subject!

responses.defaultText: Clearly I really should know all about this, tell me more!
No thanks, I'm content not knowing about such an amazing thing.

part 2a.defaultText: Awesome! I'll break it down for you in three easy lessons: what it is, how it's used, and how you can get more.

responses.defaultText: What is energy?
How is energy used?
How do I obtain more energy?
Your lessons have energized me! I'm off to adventure, bye!

part 3a.defaultText: Energy is a very special power that is constantly emanating from the core of this world. It is totally stable and will never be lost unless traded or spent. (You can see how much energy you have on the energy module in your arsenal.)

responses.defaultText: I have another question for you.
Your lessons have energized me! I'm off to adventure, bye!

part 3b.defaultText:
Energy is used for all sorts of things! It's the primary currency for buying goods from the Supply Depot, it allows you to purchase upgrades for yourself, revive yourself in the Clockworks when you run out of Sparks of Life, and it's required to form a guild. 

You'll also find all sorts of devices in the world that are powered up by using energy. Just look for the blue energy symbol on the device.

responses.defaultText: I have another question for you.
Your lessons have energized me! I'm off to adventure, bye!

part 3c.defaultText: Energy can only be obtained by purchase with a real money transaction or for trade via the Exchange. To purchase or trade for energy, simply open the Supply Depot and click the 'Get Energy' button.

responses.defaultText: I have another question for you.
Your lessons have energized me! I'm off to adventure, bye!

part 1a.defaultText: Hello there little one. You look as though you require knowledge of some kind.

responses.defaultText: Tell me what you know about the gremlins.
Nothing at this time, thanks.

part 2a.defaultText: My knowledge is yours, little one.

responses.defaultText: What exactly are gremlins?
Do the gremlins have a leader?
Are there any friendly gremlins within the Clockworks?
Actually, I have to run. Maybe some other time...

part 3a.defaultText: Gremlins are a race of creatures who are incredibly adept at creating and dismantling all manners of machinery. They are at once a legion of brilliant artificers and a force of powerful destruction.

responses.defaultText: I've got another question.
Thanks for the info tall guy, see you around town.

part 3b.defaultText: All gremlins belonging to the colony serve King Tinkinzar. Tinkinzar is said to be a great ruler and mechanical genius, responsible for the vision of the whole of the Clockworks. It is our understanding however that the king is never seen by common gremlins, but instead his orders are delivered and carried out by his Crimson Order, a fearful and zealous band of gremlins who alone share audience with the great king.

responses.defaultText: I've got another question.
Thanks for the info tall guy, see you around town.

part 3c.defaultText: Most of them will attack you on sight, but there are some; outcasts from the colony, that have taken refuge in the towns below the surface. Theirs is a hard life, hated by their own kind and no longer in a world they call home.

responses.defaultText: I've got another question.
Thanks for the info tall guy, see you around town.

part 1a.defaultText: Greetings and welcome to Haven!  If you head north, you'll reach the Arcade where you can get up to speed on the details of our mission.  If you head west, you'll reach the Bazaar, where the Strangers have a selection of gear and weapons for sale.  Be sure to check their stock daily, it changes!

responses.defaultText: Thanks for the information, I'm off to explore!
